answer_1.quote: Question Generation (QG) aims at generating a valid and fluent question according to a given passage and an optional target answer.

answer_2.quote: To evaluate the performance, we calculate several metrics, including BERT-Score, CIDEr, METEOR, BLEU, ROUGE, and Distinct scores.

answer_4.quote: To assess the quality of our generated questions, we conduct a human evaluation involving an expert with proficiency in English and a background in Computer Science and Engineering.
answer_4.guideline: We instruct the evaluator to rate each question on a scale of 0 to 4...considering the following three criteria: (1) Context Relevance... (2) Engagement Index... (3) Fluency...
